description_en: Call DescribeSlowLogRecords to query slow log records

kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse describe-slow-log-records --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id cc-bp100p4q1g9z30000 --start-time 2023-09-11_16:00:00 --end-time 2023-09-15_16:00:00 --query-duration-ms 3000 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --computing-group-id cc-wz9v6y29y3000000-clickhouse --api-version 2023-05-22 --region cn-hangzhou
